entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2433)
release_notes: Import transcripts from earlier meetings and bring their confirmed follow-ups into your next meeting. A From last time card shows what is open, done or carried before you start recording and while you meet.

The summary model picker now ends with an Automatic setting that picks the right balance of memory and speed for your Mac, and a slider to choose it yourself, from lowest memory to fastest. When your Mac runs low on memory during a meeting, Auldera eases off without changing your model.
None — internal test-lane bookkeeping only.

The summary model picker now shows only the models that suit your Mac, each with a speed and a quality rating in dots. If a model you chose is no longer offered, Auldera switches you to the best fit once and tells you, then clears the old model's files after your next meeting summary.
You can now save a meeting's live thread trace from its Export menu, and a full log export can include it when you choose to add raw files.
Macs with 24 GB or more of memory can now pick a faster build of the 12B model for summaries. It downloads a small helper along with the model and writes summaries faster.
A Project name in a narrow meeting window now shows as much of the name as fits, with an ellipsis, instead of a single cut-off letter.
Linking earlier meetings to an upcoming one is more reliable: the app now always confirms the link or tells you it could not be saved.
Local summaries use less memory on long meetings.
None — test-suite hardening only; no user-visible change.
Review commitments and pinned moments when you stop recording. Keep, edit or dismiss items, or skip the review in one tap. You can also edit and dismiss items after reopening the meeting.
You can listen to a single line of a meeting transcript and confirm whether it was said by you or another participant.

When you start recording while more than one meeting is on your calendar, you can pick which meeting it is right below the top bar, or change or unlink a recording's calendar event later from Meeting actions.
The menu bar now names the meeting you are in and how much time is left, and the menu lists today's and tomorrow's meetings next to Start and Stop.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2378)
release_notes: Recordings started from an upcoming meeting now stay in the open project, without extra notification banners.
When speaker names or speaker attribution change after a meeting summary is written, the meeting actions menu now offers to regenerate the summary.
Diagnostic reports now include response timings from the workspace.
When a topic wraps up, Auldera can still offer a link to an earlier thread even if you named the project late in the conversation.
During first-run setup you can connect this Mac's calendars so Auldera can show your next meeting and name recordings from it. You can skip it. Recording never waits on a calendar.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2327)
release_notes: Meetings that synced without their summary now get a fresh summary, which reaches your other devices. If the summary service can't be reached when a meeting ends, the meeting now says the model was unavailable and offers Rewrite, instead of saying generation failed.
In a meeting's transcript, speech that speaker detection couldn't match to anyone now reads "Unknown", the same as in the meeting's document and export, instead of "Others".
Deleting a meeting also removes the notes and topics it produced. They stay gone after a restart.
Sync uses fewer background requests while your library is unchanged.
Fix a preparation edit made during a call not updating the live questions: edited questions now show their new wording and count as covered only once the conversation actually covers them.

Open any finished meeting to see its summary, topics and action items in one place. Keep or assign an item, mark it open, done or carried, and play the moment it came from. Tell Auldera what it got right or wrong with a thumbs up or down. New installs keep recordings on your Mac until you delete them; existing installs keep their chosen setting, which you can change in Settings.

Saved meeting documents and Markdown exports now show Speaker 1, Speaker 2, and so on, and update as soon as you name a speaker or move a line to another speaker, on this Mac or another of your devices.
Join a video call or start recording it right from an upcoming meeting row or its preparation page, and open Google Calendar events in your browser.
Meetings keep syncing after you delete a meeting whose upload had paused.
You can review and link earlier meetings while preparing a recurring meeting, then undo the group if needed.
Thread suggestions now work with Enhanced without downloading a writing model. Their files are counted correctly in storage and can be removed.
Crash reports and diagnostics now always send in the beta, so Settings no longer has a switch to turn them off.
Asking a question about a meeting now clears the question box once the answer arrives, and keeps the question when an answer fails or times out so you can try again.
Your spoken promises keep appearing if Auldera Enhanced goes offline or reaches its daily limit.
With Invitation details turned on, Google Calendar meetings now show who is invited, the organizer, the agenda, and the location, as Apple Calendar meetings already do.
Get a reminder before each meeting, with an action to join and record, record an in-person meeting, or open your preparation.
Keep track of topics, commitments and questions while you record. Press Command-M to mark the last thirty seconds and add a short label.

See relevant earlier meetings while preparing or reviewing a meeting. Read their dated summaries and earlier next steps, add a meeting from your library, or remove a suggestion for this meeting or its series with Undo.
Questions you carry forward now also appear in a recurring meeting after someone moves it to a different time.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2281)
release_notes: Your existing calendar choices carry over. Choose which calendars appear in your schedule and can start automatic recording; new calendars stay unchecked until you choose them.
Carry a preparation question into later meetings, edit it, or mark it addressed without copying it again.
Start recording without waiting for Google Calendar. Calendar refreshes skip calendars you don’t watch and load the rest more efficiently.
None. Lane timing and host placement change for agents; the app does not.
Choose or clear a project on an upcoming meeting without writing preparation notes.
The Auldera Enhanced confirmation now also explains that transcript text is sent while you record.
Auldera now frees its transcription and summary models' memory when a recording finishes, and reloads them when you start the next one.
Keyboard navigation returns you to the upcoming meeting you opened when you go back to your meeting list.
Preparation notes stay editable when you return after opening another meeting.
Preparation notes stay with the meeting they belong to when you switch meetings.
Speaker detection now gives unnamed voices clear numbers in transcripts and summaries.
Up next now shows your schedule even when your meeting history is slow to load or can't be read.
Recorded meetings stay out of Up next and Upcoming when you reopen Auldera.
Starting a new recording asks the previous meeting's final summary to stop and keeps the summary already saved.

You can open an upcoming meeting from the list and write notes for it before it starts. Those notes stay with the meeting while you record and after you stop. A meeting you prepared but did not record stays in the list as Preparation.
Builds on the Studio now wait only when free disk falls under 30 GB, and the refusal message names the Auldera outputs to clean up and the command for each.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2220)
release_notes: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Ah6sWEXX3ASdwPdLRGGVRK
If your microphone drops out for a moment during a meeting, for example when a headset reconnects, Auldera now picks it back up within a few seconds instead of ending the microphone recording.
Sync can fetch changed meetings in fewer requests and recover after a response reaches its size limit.
Diagnostic exports now show whether background diagnostic delivery was working, paused or waiting, and why.
Recordings on unstable audio routes keep the diagnostic evidence that explains them.

Record remembers which calendar occurrence you started from, including a repeating meeting. Who is invited, the agenda, and the location stay unread until you turn Invitation details on in Calendar settings.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2205)
release_notes: Delegated-by: speaker-n-macos-2779-20261016-002427-9747 devin-swe (swe-2-max, max)
New accounts agree to the latest Privacy Policy, which now explains how Auldera uses your calendars.
Browser access requests can appear automatically after a temporary sync pause ends.

Check for Updates opens a window with the result, including when you are already up to date. When an update is ready, you can read the notes, skip this version, or apply and relaunch. A quiet icon appears while an optional update is waiting. Automatic updates can be turned on in that window or in Settings.
Stopping a successful recording no longer reopens your microphone and system audio just to recheck them.

When one Google calendar cannot be read, the rest of that account still shows. Upcoming lists the meetings that answered, and says it could not check every calendar when nothing remains. Settings still lists every calendar, with the unread one quieter.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2183)
release_notes: Calendar permission that is off, managed by an organization, or write-only each has its own sentence, so Upcoming does not look like an empty day.
Recordings can finish more reliably when online transcription switches back to your Mac.
The title bar reliably lets you rename a meeting while it records.
Today's meetings now show in Upcoming even when automatic recording is off. You can start one yourself, and Auldera will not start recording on its own until you turn automatic recording back on.
None: lab-only.
Edits you make to a meeting while it syncs no longer flicker back to an older value, and a note you type during sync is no longer replaced.
If Sync waits too long for your iCloud Keychain, it now stops waiting after 15 minutes and offers Reset Sync, instead of waiting silently.
Sync waits quietly when the server asks it to slow down, then catches up in one go, so it stops retrying every minute.
Sync finishes faster after a network hiccup or a busy moment on the server, and your meeting list stays responsive while it runs.
After a speaker rename syncs between your Macs, a summary that already uses the new name no longer says it is behind your edits.
None. Diagnostics only.
After you rename a speaker or move a line to another speaker, Rewrite writes a summary that uses those names.
Auldera no longer asks for your Mac password to open its saved keys after an update. If a key saved by an older test build can't be read, Settings asks you to enter it again.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2133)
release_notes: While you record, the Private switch now sits next to Stop, and you can tell at a glance whether the meeting is private: a closed lock on a filled button means it is.
Copying a summary is now a small copy button at the right of the Summary heading, and it shows a check once the summary is copied.
Before you pick a summary model, Settings now shows the model your summaries actually use, and the model list marks it.
You can move a line of a transcript to the right speaker from any of your devices. The summary tells you it's behind your edits, so you can rewrite it when you choose.
If installing an update needs your Mac password, Auldera now asks you first instead of waiting on a password prompt.
Meetings now open on their summary, so you see what was decided first. Your notes are one tab away.
Your meeting name now updates while you record, once the live summary suggests one. Names you type or get from your calendar stay in place.
You can now mark any meeting Private from any of your devices, including meetings recorded on another device. Private meetings stay out of Project summaries everywhere.
The live transcript now keeps up with new speech while you record, instead of stopping and asking you to jump to the latest line.
Choose how much detail your summaries have. Pick Concise, Balanced or Detailed in Settings > AI, and new summaries follow it.
You can name a speaker in a synchronized meeting from any of your devices. The summary tells you when it is behind your edits, so you can rewrite it when you choose.

Review fixes: an origin whose Sync is paused still queues a name, so an older row cannot mask it; a name that pins the Summary re-reads the open pane; a refused local name pins nothing; an edit made while Rewrite runs keeps its mark.
Opening Settings no longer starts a full sync each time, so Sync stays quicker and avoids hitting the server's limits.
Recording now starts when nothing is playing on your Mac. If a recording can't start, the message says whether the microphone or Mac audio was the problem.
Asking about a meeting now always shows an answer, an error, or a "took too long" message within 30 seconds, and keeps your question so you can try again.

You can now choose what happens when a meeting starts. Keep the short countdown with Cancel, or pick Auto-join to start recording right away. Detailed logging in Advanced now explains itself in one short sentence.
Sync now tells you when a meeting cannot be synced. Other meetings keep syncing, and unchanged damaged meetings no longer slow each Sync pass.
Choose Fast, Balanced, or Best summaries from one model sheet. Download and delete models there, and see which model best fits your Mac.
Settings > Account brings your account and Sync storage together. Open Devices for device and browser access, and find your meetings and Markdown files under On this Mac.
Retrying update access now shows progress or explains what to do next.
Syncing larger meeting libraries uses less background CPU and finishes warm sync checks faster.
Find login, notifications, updates, and help together in App settings. Update access now shows the action you need only when something needs attention.
You can move any synchronized meeting into or out of a Project from any of your devices.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2095)
release_notes: You can send app logs to Auldera when you export them. The export tells you whether they were sent and keeps a copy on your Mac.
Settings › Advanced is simpler: detailed logging, crash reports, and Export Logs sit together, your account tools are on one card, and developer-only Zoom tools stay out of the way.
When a meeting synced from your other Mac goes into an Enhanced summary or question, that Mac now records it too, so each Mac's privacy record stays complete.
If your sign-in on this Mac stops working for good, Auldera now signs you out cleanly so you can sign in again. You no longer need to reset sign-in.
You can record with microphones and webcams that use a lower audio rate, including the Logitech C925e.
In two-person Zoom meetings, Auldera names the other person more often, including when Zoom shows no participant count or a single read briefly fails.
Auldera can name Zoom speakers in group meetings from the order of the gallery tiles, and it now reads meetings on free Zoom accounts.
Minimising the Zoom window, switching to speaker view, or pinning someone no longer stops your recording.
You can edit your meeting notes after recording, from any of your devices, and the summary tells you when it is behind your notes.

If a Mac could not sync Projects and Tags because their saved changes were damaged, Settings now offers Repair. Repair keeps your newest edits from other devices. A Mac that already has Projects or Tags waits for its first sync before you can change them.
Keep audio is now one simple menu, from Always to Until notes are written. New installs keep recordings for 30 days.
Naming Zoom speakers fills in your name, so it never turns on without one. The Accessibility reminder only appears when it's actually off.
Settings › AI now says where transcription and summaries run, and what each choice sends, in one sentence under each choice. A status appears only when something needs your attention.

Settings > Calendar is simpler. Your Apple and Google calendars are in one list grouped by account, and each account shows its status next to the one button it needs. If calendars can't be loaded, Try Again now works for Apple Calendar too. Meetings now always take their calendar event's name.
You can now create, rename, recolour, archive, and delete projects right in Settings > Projects & Tags. Archived projects sit in their own fold, and the word you use for projects sits at the top.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2066)
release_notes: The recording capsule, the menu bar window, About, and What's New now match Auldera's new look, with warm paper backgrounds and the new typefaces. The capsule stays easy to read over any app.
You can rename a meeting from any of your devices, and the new name appears on the others.

Auldera's Mac windows, capture capsule and menu bar now use the Folio look: warm paper backgrounds, a brick accent, and the Newsreader, Instrument Sans and IBM Plex Mono typefaces where text uses the new type roles.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2063)
release_notes: Two Macs on one account now show the same project summary, and a Rewrite on one Mac replaces it on the other. A meeting recorded on another device shows the summary that device wrote.
Auldera has a new icon: seven bars with one tall red bar, in the Dock, in Finder, and in the menu bar. It also has a dark version for dark icon styles.
Speaker names, tag dots, and the meeting window's other colours now come from Auldera's own paper-and-ink palette, so every speaker reads clearly in light and dark.
You can now see Sync at work: the bottom of your meeting list and Sync settings show when your meetings last synced, a progress bar while they sync, and what to do if Sync stops.
Auldera now tells you when a recording starts if Zoom speaker names can't work because Accessibility is off, with a button to open System Settings and one to check again.
If Auldera already shows as allowed but names still don't work, it tells you how to fix it.
The Mac app no longer freezes for seconds when your list of synced meetings refreshes.
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Settings is easier to find your way around: Account, Recording, Calendar, AI, Projects & Tags, App, and Advanced.
Every meeting now shows in your lists, however short. You no longer need an option to see recordings under a minute.
Changes you make on one Mac now show up on your other Mac by themselves, within about a minute, without you having to open anything.
Settings no longer asks you to finish activating private updates when your Mac already gets updates without it.
Auldera's meeting window and Settings have a lighter, cleaner look. Summaries and transcripts read in a clear book typeface, and buttons, tabs, and lists use a crisp modern one.
What's New now tells you what's new in Auldera in plain, simple words.
